Three malicious RubyGems packages published in July 2026 evaded CI detection by targeting developer laptops directly, researchers say. Security researchers at Aikido Security identified and named the campaign SleeperGem after tracing malicious releases of three RubyGems packages pushed to the public registry between July 18 and July 19, 2026.
